phase0_grounding.connections: Org and Hotlist both use protected $connection = 'zod' (Postgres). Query hits the zod read replica by default (read PDO).
phase0_grounding.schema_ownership: public.hotlist / public.orgs schema+indexes are managed by the vendor package insight-lpr/laravel-zod-migrations (database/schema/zod-schema.sql). Platform has ONE zod-connection migration (add_plate_variants_function.php) and it GUARDS `config('app.env') !== 'production'` — i.e. platform zod migrations are dev-only; platform does not own the zod schema in production.
